test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'** i.e. **'common'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **blank requires an adjective** that describes the frequency or general acceptability of the discharge of contaminated effluent with minimal or no treatment.
 
• **'Common' **fits perfectly in this context as it refers to something that happens often or is prevalent. 
 
• So, in this sentence, it expresses that untreated or minimally treated contaminated effluent discharge was a common occurrence.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is 'Option 2' i.e.** 'common'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Maniac'** refers to a person who exhibits extreme enthusiasm or desire for something. It doesn't fit into the context of this sentence.
 
• **'Bogus'** means not genuine or true (used in a disapproving manner when deception has been attempted). This word doesn't make any sense in the context of the sentence.
 
• **'Ruckus'** refers to a disturbance or commotion. This word also doesn't fit suitable in the given context.
